detailed_findings.finding: The proof correctly constructs the image S = f(A) and observes S ⊆ B.
The argument that f, viewed as A → S, is bijective is correct and complete.
The final inequality follows validly from |A| = |S| and |S| ≤ |B| for a finite subset S of B.

reason: The proof is a standard and complete argument: it forms the image S = f(A), notes S ⊆ B, shows f : A → S is bijective (surjective by definition of image and injective inherited from the original map), deduces |A| = |S|, and then uses the finite-subset cardinal inequality |S| ≤ |B| to conclude |A| ≤ |B|. This matches the lemma statement exactly and aligns with the intended assembly role of converting an injection into a cardinality inequality.
